subject: Factor scores after GRM estimation to be appended to dataset

messages.author: 8a8502cb4b001f99
messages.subject: Factor scores after GRM estimation to be appended to dataset
parts:
Hi Phil

I have generated factor scores following estimation of GRM - my question is how do I append the factor scores generated to the data.frame used in model estimation ? rather than the factor scores being a separate data frame.

Thanks,
Paul

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Re: Factor scores after GRM estimation to be appended to dataset
parts:
Just do this;

mod1 <- mirt(Science, 1)
df <- data.frame(fscores(mod1, QMC = T))

That's it.

Seongho

messages.subject: Re: Factor scores after GRM estimation to be appended to dataset
parts:
Do you mean just join them onto the original dataset? If so,

mod <- mirt(Science, 1)
fs <- fscores(mod)
newScience <- data.frame(Science, fs)
head(newScience)

Phil
